_comment: MSP / IT-services businesses for sale in Texas. UNVERIFIED first-pass capture from public marketplace summaries (BizBuySell + BizQuest) — every figure must be confirmed against the actual listing / CIM before it informs a decision. Many financials sit behind marketplace login walls and are recorded as null. sde = Seller's Discretionary Earnings (BizBuySell 'Cash Flow'). To refresh: edit this array and re-run `node tools/msp-deal-scanner/scan.mjs`.
primarySource: BizBuySell + BizQuest — IT / managed-services businesses for sale in Texas

listings.headline: High-Margin, Customized IT Services Business (150 clients, 7 states)
listings.notes: Established 2007; 150 clients across 7 states (multi-state = remote-delivering, operable from Dallas). Team ~7: 6 full-time + 1 part-time + a CONTRACTOR acting as operations manager, plus a lead support specialist with 17 yrs tenure. 2023 rev ~$3.2M / adj EBITDA ~$1.7M (~53% margin — very high for an MSP; QoE/add-backs are the first diligence item), 2024 pace ~$1.86M. Broker: Transworld Houston (BW2304615). Price gated. RISKS: the 'GM' is a contractor (transferability), key-person concentration on the 17-yr tech, and lean staffing may be under-investment a buyer must restore. Above the Deal-1 SBA sweet spot on size.

listings.headline: IT Managed Services Company (Round Rock)
listings.notes: Managed services; normalized EBITDA $824,911 confirmed. Asking price NOT reliably known — search surfaced conflicting figures ($3.03M and $1.76M) that could not be verified; treat as price-on-request. Round Rock = Austin metro. Right size band for Deal 1.
